title: Permit review times against similar issued permits
question: Were the seven issued permits slow relative to others filed under similar conditions?
finding: The church conversion at 150 Eureka took 1,087 days. One of 99 other issued permits in its group took at least as long. The same address’s seismic permit took two days, the median among 13,734 comparable over-the-counter permits.
how: The November 12 extract supplied 62,273 distinct permits filed in 2019–20 eligible for comparison. Groups use filing year, DBI permit type, estimated cost band and whether DBI marks a site permit. The 12 disclosed permits are excluded from comparison groups. Percentiles use the nearest-rank method.
limits: The 99-permit group had 21 additional applications without a recorded issue date. Station intervals can overlap and include time awaiting a response. For the church conversion, a 369-day Planning interval included a 368-day hold. A second station interval lasted 462 days. A missing hold date does not establish who was responsible.
